title: Cambridge Study: Terrorists Are Building Their Own AI Labs
description:
Cambridge just published the first academic proof that terrorist groups are running there own AI labs 😳

Researchers did 57 interviews with former members, and what they found is grim. These groups are using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and DeepSeek to plan attacks, build explosives and keep weapons running. ISIS apparently been training commanders to slip past the safety filters since 2023.

The scary part isnt just that they try it. Its that it works. OpenAI and Anthropic have admited themselves there is no real way to fully block this stuff 🔥 the filters are failing systematicaly, not just once in a while.

Basicaly the study says AI companys can't regulate themselfs, and now theres data to back it up ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
